Equation 7.1:
\mu=\mu_{\max} \frac{[GLC]}{K_{\mathrm{glc}}+[GLC]}\cdot\frac{[GLN]}{K_{\mathrm{g}\ln}+[GLN]}\cdot\frac{\mathrm{KI}_{\mathrm{lac}}}{KI_{\mathrm{lac}}+[LAC]} \cdot\frac{\mathrm{KI}_{\mathrm{amm}}}{KI_{\mathrm{amm}}+[AMM]}

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  \mu  ->  mu   (Specific cell growth rate)
  [AMM]  ->  AMM   (ammonia concentration)
  [GLC]  ->  GLC   (Glucose concentration)
  [GLN]  ->  GLN   (Glutamine concentration)
  [LAC]  ->  LAC   (lactate concentration)
  KI_{amm}  ->  KIamm   (Half-maximum-rate concentration of ammonia for cell growth rate)
  KI_{lac}  ->  KIlac   (Half-maximum-rate concentration of lactate for cell growth rate)
  K_{glc}  ->  Kglc   (half-maximum-rate concentration of glucose for cell growth rate)
  K_{gln}  ->  Kgln   (half-maximum-rate concentration of glutamine for cell growth rate)
  \mu_{\max}  ->  mumax   (maximum specific cell growth rate)

answer.rhs: mumax * GLC / (Kglc + GLC) * GLN / (Kgln + GLN) * KIlac / (KIlac + LAC) * KIamm / (KIamm + AMM)
